notes.title: Check Out Our New Game: The Path of Motus
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've spent the last three years working on a new game called The Path of Motus. It's launching this Tuesday (July 17th) on Steam! Even though it explores different themes, it's definitely a spiritual sequel to Pillar. The gameplay is very puzzle based and was designed to communicate specific ideas just like Pillar does.

You can purchase the game (or wishlist it) here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/710690/The_Path_of_Motus/

Thanks for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game!

Michael

notes.title: Pillar Coming May 29th to Steam
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Excited to announce Pillar is coming May 29th to Steam.

Pillar made it's debut last February on PlayStation 4, Xbox 360 and the Humble Store. Pillar will launch on Steam with the option of buying the standard version, or a deluxe version that includes the game's soundtrack, an album of bonus tracks, concept art and more!

The game was made by a team of two, so purchasing it really helps us a ton. You can find out more about Pillar and read nice things people have said about it at our website: http://pillar-game.com

You can also read about the game and view some media on our Steam page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/371900/

Thanks so much everyone, excited to see new people play at launch!

Michael
